description: Get today's USDT (stablecoin dollar) rate in an African currency: what 1 USDT costs and fetches in local currency, the official exchange rate, and the premium between them. Answers questions like 'USDT to naira rate', 'how much is 1 USDT in cedi', 'black market dollar rate in Ghana' or 'parallel rate in Egypt'. Accepts a currency code (NGN), a country (Nigeria, NG) or a currency name (naira). From the Mansa Markets Stablecoin Premium Index, measured hourly across named P2P marketplaces; returns sample size, venues, timestamp and a citation line.

currency.description: Currency code (NGN, GHS, KES, EGP, XOF...), country name or ISO-2 code (Nigeria, GH), or currency name (naira, cedi).

name: get_stablecoin_rate
title: USDT rate today in an African currency
